title: WorkAccess - Data API
description: Used to grant or restrict user access to give badge definitions. Each badge definition record must have one WorkAccess record.

AccessType.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
AccessType.description: Define the type of Access given to user (“Give”).

OwnerId.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
OwnerId.description: Salesforce unique ID for owner of Access record. This is a polymorphic relationship field.

ParentId.description: Salesforce unique ID for BadgeDefinition record associated with this Access record. This is a relationship field.

associated_objects:
This object has the following associated objects. Unless noted, they are available in the same API version as this object.

- **WorkAccessChangeEvent (API version 62.0)**: Change events are available for the object.
- **WorkAccessOwnerSharingRule**: Sharing rules are available for the object.
- **WorkAccessShare**: The original WDC feature is unavailable as of Spring '22. This object isn't available as of API version 54.0. For more information, see Phased WDC (legacy Work.com) Feature Retirement.
